Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files and demands ransom
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies using vssadmin.exe to prevent recovery
Uses ransom note files named Howto_RESTORE_FILES.txt, Howto_RESTORE_FILES.html, and Howto_RESTORE_FILES.bmp
Creates autostart entry in Windows Registry named Acrndtd to maintain persistence
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note filenames: Howto_RESTORE_FILES.txt, Howto_RESTORE_FILES.html, Howto_RESTORE_FILES.bmp
Use of vssadmin.exe to delete Shadow Volume Copies
